rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Trick 1: Classification test: number of C atoms bonded to the carbinol carbon (1°/2°/3°) — decide BEFORE choosing oxidant: 1° → aldehyde/acid, 2° → ketone, 3° → no oxidation (dehydration instead).  ·  Trick 2: Preparation bank: hydration of alkenes (Markovnikov, H2SO4), hydroboration (anti-Markovnikov), reduction of carbonyls (NaBH4/LiAlH4), Grignard + aldehyde/ketone, alkyl halide + aq. KOH.
